items.title: N Brown selects Fynd for retail workflow automation
summary: On 25 November, Fynd announced that UK fashion retailer N Brown had selected its Boltic platform to connect systems and automate workflows.
The planned implementation starts with Ambrose Wilson before extending to other N Brown brands.
items.why: Retailers need reliable links between order, inventory and returns systems when modernising their technology.

language.example: The team selected a platform to manage candidate records.
